findings.title: Customer reports no platform issues; admin side trouble-free
findings.description: Customer states the platform 'just works' and that his admin (Renata) has never escalated any issue to him. This is general positive feedback with no defect or missing capability identified, and no change is being requested.
findings.quote: Honestly it just works. My assistant handles the admin side and she's never escalated anything to me
findings.severity_reason: No defect or request present; purely positive feedback with nothing for an engineer to act on.
findings.match_note: No catalogue issue applies; there is no problem described, only satisfaction with the product.

findings.title: Customer reports mobile app performs well for on-the-go booking, no complaints
findings.description: Customer says trainers book sessions from their phones between clients, describing the app as fast with no complaints. No defect or feature gap is raised.
findings.quote: The app's great, actually. Most of them book from their phones between clients. It's fast, no complaints.
findings.severity_reason: Purely positive feedback; no defect, no request, nothing actionable for engineering.
findings.match_note: No catalogue issue applies; customer explicitly states there are no complaints about the mobile app.

findings.title: Customer confirms value of dark mode for mobile app (already shipped)
findings.description: Customer volunteers that dark mode is well-liked by trainers working early-morning and late-night shifts, citing eye comfort. This references functionality already released rather than requesting anything new.
findings.quote: The dark mode thing was a hit too, weirdly. Trainers work early mornings and late nights, dark screens are easier on the eyes.
findings.severity_reason: Positive confirmation of an already-shipped feature; no outstanding defect or gap to address.
findings.match_note: Matches PROJ-102 (Dark mode for mobile app, shipped 4.2); customer is praising it, not requesting anything further.

findings.title: Bulk provisioning of new-location staff worked smoothly, no issues reported
findings.description: Customer describes his admin bulk-adding new staff at two newly opened locations, with all accounts active within a day and no hiccups reported. No defect or missing capability is identified.
findings.quote: Smooth. Renata bulk-added them and they were up within a day. No hiccups I heard about.
findings.severity_reason: Positive report of successful bulk provisioning; no defect or gap for engineering to act on.
findings.match_note: No catalogue issue applies (contrast with PROJ-131, which is about search indexing delay, not provisioning/activation, and isn't mentioned here).

findings.title: Coach-matching consideration for future downtown location's different trainer profile
findings.description: Customer notes an upcoming downtown location will have a different trainer profile (more career-focused, corporate-adjacent) than existing locations. Internal rep suggests possibly tuning coach matching for this group in a future conversation, but this is a service/matching planning discussion rather than a described product defect or a concrete feature request from the customer.
findings.quote: Downtown's a different crowd though — more corporate clients, fewer walk-ins. Different trainer profile. Does that change anything on your end?
findings.severity_reason: Speculative, forward-looking service consideration for a location that isn't open yet; not a product defect or specific feature ask.
findings.match_note: No catalogue issue applies; this concerns coaching/matching service configuration, not a product capability gap, and is deferred to a future conversation.
